title: FAKE REVIEWS? Avoid This New MSFS Aircraft!
description:
The MSFS Marketplace just got two very different additions, and one of them is causing a massive stir in the community. Today, we're diving into the CAC Boomerang by Aeroplane Heaven and the highly controversial Boeing 737-100 from Scenery Creation.

The CAC Boomerang is a beautiful piece of Australian aviation history. While it’s a solid "Local Legend," I’ve encountered some specific MSFS 2024 bugs, including pilot model issues and canopy glitches. We look at the Pratt & Whitney R-1830 performance and that unique wooden frame construction.

However, the real story is the 737-100. Despite a 4.7-star rating, the community is calling out "Scenery Creation" (formerly MScenery) for what many describe as low-fidelity "junk" products and potentially manipulated reviews. We investigate the lack of cockpit screenshots and why the community is filtering out this vendor.

Is the Boomerang going in your hangar, or have you been burned by these Marketplace releases? Let me know in the comments!
